name: 旅行回憶樂園
prompt:
Create a production-quality illustration asset for chicTrip Memory Atlas travel app. Square composition, high resolution. A delightful sophisticated miniature theme park island seen from high isometric aerial view, tactile painted wooden model / premium handcrafted stop-motion scenery, meticulously detailed yet clean, sunny soft shadows, turquoise teal calm sea, ivory sand paths, fresh sage grass, coral and chicTrip cyan/yellow accents. NO text, NO typography, NO labels, NO UI, NO borders, NO Mario characters. Full island comfortably inside frame with 8% sea margin. Four clearly separate architectural destinations connected with gently curving ivory paths to a central circular cream plaza and small round fountain. 
Precise composition: TOP LEFT centered x27% y30% is an elegant blue observatory departure terminal with large blue globe on roof, small airship/mooring tower and tiny runway. TOP RIGHT centered x73% y30% is a playful build-your-travel-town workshop, miniature Japanese houses, tiny snowcapped Fuji, red torii and stacked architectural building blocks on terraced green land. BOTTOM LEFT centered x27% y67% is travel collection museum shaped like beautiful open scrapbook with thick cream pages and teal cover, enamel mountain pin, small deer sticker and ticket shaped structures around it. BOTTOM RIGHT centered x73% y67% is cheerful striped cyan-and-yellow wardrobe boutique, oversized clothing hanger roof ornament, tiny travel hat and backpack displayed outside, round mirror, dress-up pavilion. All four destinations are prominent physical buildings, not floating icons. Central fountain at x50 y49. Paths branch from center to each zone, wooden bridges across a little stream, sparse beautifully varied trees, tiny benches and lampposts, coastline dimensional layered sandstone, small dock and sailboat along bottom coast. Keep small open lawn space immediately below each destination (at y42% and y79%) for frontend labels to be superimposed later. Uppermost 12% mostly sea. Balanced charming theme park wayfinding map, refined color harmony, sharp silhouettes, miniature high-quality collectible toy craftsmanship, no fake letters anywhere, no busy clutter. Entire image is scenery, no cards or website screenshot.
reference: User-supplied amusement-park map used as conceptual direction; original geography and chicTrip destinations.
implementation: Raster illustration with independent accessible HTML hotspots and GSAP motion; not a real 3D town.
